name: CLCS 5250
title: Topics in Transnational Jewish History
description: (Also offered as HEJS 5250, HIST 5250.) Topics in Jewish history, both transnational in space (European, American, global) and diachronic in time (Early Modern to Late Modern). May be repeated with a change of topic to a maximum of six credits. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
